correctness.rationale: Exact continuous piecewise-affine zero-prefix representation, at most 2(q+1)+2 transition breakpoints, and complete pairwise-affine collision enumeration prove the algorithm. The onset analysis exhausts min-run one, the two finite min-run-two exceptions, a constructive one-third-period bound, and six possible length-six patterns. The packaged verifier cross-checks 16,642 phase counts, 2,500 onset/multiplicity cases, and 1,000 large-parameter samples; the proof, not finite testing, establishes the infinite results.
